note: Homozygous structural copy number losses (such as an 86-kb deletion of exons 3-6) in FILIP1 have been identified in cohorts presenting with arthrogryposis multiplex congenita and microcephaly.

evidence.text: A systematic analysis of homozygous autosomal copy number losses in exomes from a resource-limited cohort of 2021 individuals identified a biallelic FILIP1 exon 3-6 deletion associated with multiple joint contractures, scoliosis, and microcephaly.

source.title: Systematic analysis of homozygous autosomal copy number losses in exomes improves diagnostic yield and uncovers ultra-rare recessive disorders
source.quote: FILIP1 exon 3-6 deletion (NM_015687.5), multiple joint contractures, scoliosis, microcephaly, … support the existence of FILIP1-related arthrogryposis with microcephaly

evidence.text: In a study describing homozygous loss-of-function variants in FILIP1 causing arthrogryposis multiplex congenita with microcephaly across five affected individuals in three families, one family harbored an 86-kb homozygous deletion spanning FILIP1 exons 3–6.

source.title: Homozygous loss-of-function variants in FILIP1 cause autosomal recessive arthrogryposis multiplex congenita with microcephaly
source.quote: Copy number analysis by qPCR was used for segregation analysis of a 86-kb homozygous deletion spanning FILIP1 exons 3–6 in family 3
